{{Top|leg}}
'''Merith''' was an [[Alderaanian/Legends|Alderaanian]] individual, who served aboard the [[Alderaanian gunship]] [[Aegis (Alderaanian gunship)|''Aegis'']] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. After the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction of Alderaan]]. the crew of the gunship, including Merith, became [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]], under the command of [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Caline Metara]]. After Metara's death, Merith and the rest of the Aegis crew helped the rebels, and above all Princess [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], in their plan to board the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] freighter ''Darsumae'' and free the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel]] hostages captured by [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] [[Degoren]].<ref name="Razor's Edge">''[[Razor's Edge]]''</ref>
